registry_sources.access_notes: Read the authority information page and linked public register form; no searches submitted. Company and address filters are search attributes; they do not establish a separately registered practice entity. The retrieved page contains startup and searching-issue text. Search functionality was not exercised, so live availability is unconfirmed.
registry_sources.source_scope: Public form and authority description only; no person-level registry extraction.

registry_sources.access_notes: The directory landing page states a limit of three free searches per day per IP address without a subscription. The verification form shows a registration-number input and a security-code challenge. The directory landing page lists search modes. Zero name, number, state, city, postcode or other registry searches were submitted. No subscription was purchased and no challenge was attempted. The result URL opened without parameters exposed no usable search fields; entry-form metadata comes from the linked verification and directory pages.
registry_sources.source_scope: Public entry information and form metadata only; query quota was not intentionally consumed.

registry_sources.access_notes: Read the public register form only; no searches submitted. Two select controls were present without readable labels in the extracted page; their meanings remain unclassified. The page also contains an architect login area. Its credential fields are not register search fields and were not used. A practice/place-of-work filter does not by itself establish a separately registered practice entity.
registry_sources.source_scope: Public register form only; no individual records or totals captured.

registry_sources.authority: California Architects Board; search hosted by California Department of Consumer Affairs
registry_sources.access_notes: The California Architects Board explicitly states that it licenses individual architects, not firms or corporations. The authority information page describes name, city, county and licence-number search; the linked shared DCA form was inspected without submitting a query. The DCA form serves multiple professions. A generic business-name field does not imply that CAB licenses architecture firms. The advanced-search link timed out during retrieval. Its additional fields were not verified.
registry_sources.source_scope: Authority description and shared search form only; no licence records extracted.

registry_sources.access_notes: Separate forms search individuals and listed business entities; neither form was submitted. The authority explains that a business entity using the architect description must nominate a responsible architect and appear on its corporations-and-firms list. Record a business listing separately from each nominated architect and that person’s registration; do not collapse them into one entity.
registry_sources.source_scope: Public form and authority explanatory text only; no personal or business search-result extraction.

independent_source_review.method: Independent reopening of the primary location sources and applicable person-role sources supplied in the other workers' seed files.
independent_source_review.scope: Six records: three Americas and three Europe/Oceania. City/country, practice identity, and selected historical-person roles; no coordinate, license, or completeness audit.
